request.style: English, male solo voice with choir, harp, organ, cello, drums, solemn, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sons of Kohath are named in truth
Amram and Izhar stand together
Hebron and Uzziel follow suit
One hundred thirty three years lived here

[Verse]
The sons of Izhar are counted clear
Korah and Nepheg and Zichri too
Descendants serving the tabernacle
Their duties fixed for Levitical view

[Verse]
In David's time the Izharites stood
As officials and judges over Israel
In charge of treasuries and gifts
Dedicated for the house of God

[Verse]
Korah rose up against Moses there
With Dathan and Abiram from Reuben
Two hundred and fifty men opposed
Challenging the holy Levite men

[Verse]
Take censers and lay incense on fire
Present it before the LORD tomorrow
The man he chooses will be holy
The Levites have gone too far

[Outro]
The earth opened and swallowed them down
